verdicts.reason: A: the orange wash is gone (the background reads dark/black, so the brand colour survives only as a meaningless orange rectangle), the white frame has collapsed into a tiny empty grid box, the play icon is huge and competes with 'Pygmalion', and the credit line is squeezed into a 3-line narrow wrap. Still, the headline group on the left and the tickets copy on the right read cleanly. B: the same lost tint and broken frame, plus 'Richmond High School Theatre Presents' is crushed into a 5-word vertical stack jammed against the left edge, the collapsed frame box overlaps the orange block, and the 'Music and lyrics' credit straddles the orange block's edge, an unintended collision. That makes B the messier of two broken resizes.
